Mesh Level of Detail is a secondary optimization system applied to individual mesh instances within a voxel-based instancing framework to reduce vertex count based on camera distance [S1].

The claim states that Mesh Level of Detail is a secondary optimization system applied to individual mesh instances within a voxel-based instancing framework to reduce vertex count based on camera distance. The evidence explicitly confirms: 1) It is a 'secondary LOD system' included in the library. 2) It 'applies to meshes themselves' (individual mesh instances) and 'allows to reduce vertex count over distance'. 3) It 'only applies to VoxelInstanceLibraryMultiMeshItem', which is part of the voxel instancing framework described in the text. 4) The switch distances are defined relative to view distance, supporting the 'based on camera distance' aspect.
